    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check whether registered at an eligible university"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_UniversityEligible" name="Registered at an eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountReady" name="Account available"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into account"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConnectTwitter" name="Connect application to Twitter account"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentInfo" name="Provide payment information"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueCourseTicket" name="Issue course ticket"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_RegistrationRequested" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCheckSlots" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSlotsToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckSlots" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsFree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsAvailable" name="Slots free" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>slots are free</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsFull" name="No free slots" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowToSelectDate" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourseDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectDateToCheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourseDate" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccountToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>already have an account</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UniversityToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>registered at an eligible university</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToReady" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToWait" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToReady" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToLogIn" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountReady" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogInToTwitter" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Task_ConnectTwitter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TwitterToTweet" sourceRef="Task_ConnectTwitter" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToComplete" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteToPayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInfo" targetRef="Task_IssueCourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TicketToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueCourseTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
